Active candidates for this program must be board certified (or active candidates) and shall have ACLS for OB and NRP certification within one year of being hired.
At least one year of practice exclusive of internship; and knowledges and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to the position.

The Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at University California Irvine School of Medicine is seeking a part time OBGYN Hospitalist to join its faculty. The program is accredited and seeking 1 part time candidate. Must possess an MD or DO and have a demonstrated career focus in obstetrics.
A track record of success and highly regarded peer review is expected.
Active candidates for this program must be board certified (or active candidates) and shall have ACLS for OB and NRP certification within one year of being hired.
Incumbent shall be eligible for a faculty title, retirement and benefits packages unique to University employees.
Salary and rank shall be commensurate with education and experience; Malpractice and tail coverage shall be provided through the University.
